title: Dawki Crystal River & Mawlynnong Village Day Trip from Shillong

seo.title: Dawki & Mawlynnong Day Trip from Shillong | Kajaawa
seo.description: A full day from Shillong to the glass-clear Dawki river, the living root bridge at Riwai and Mawlynnong village, by private car or shared seat.

gallery.alt: A boat on the emerald Dawki river

facts.title: Free cancellation
facts.text: Cancel up to 24 hours before for a full refund

facts.title: Instant confirmation
facts.text: Your booking is confirmed right away

summary: Leave Shillong early, ride a boat across a river so clear it looks like glass, cross a living root bridge and walk through one of Asia's cleanest villages — back in time for dinner.
highlights: Boat across the Umngot river at Dawki, right by the Bangladesh border
Walk the single-decker living root bridge at Riwai
Explore Mawlynnong's flower-lined lanes and bamboo skywalk
See the balancing rock on the way back
description: Your driver collects you from your Shillong hotel and takes the winding road south through the Khasi hills, stopping at viewpoints over the Bangladesh plains.
At Dawki you'll take a boat out on the Umngot, then continue to Riwai for its living root bridge and to Mawlynnong for a slow walk and a local lunch before the drive back.
includes: Private or shared car with driver
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Shillong
excludes: Boat ride (₹800 – ₹1,200 per boat, paid locally)

importantInfo.title: What to bring
items: Cash for the boat and entries

importantInfo.title: Know before you go
items: Boating can close after heavy rain; you'll get a partial refund if it does

packages.name: Shared seat in a group car
packages.summary: Join other travellers; fixed departure at 7:30 am.

reviews.name: Kavya
reviews.text: The river is unreal — you can see every pebble. Our driver timed it so we beat the crowds.

reviews.name: Tom
reviews.packageName: Shared seat in a group car
reviews.text: Great value. Long day in the car but the stops are worth it.

reviews.name: Ishaan
reviews.text: Mawlynnong was spotless and the people were lovely. Highly recommend the SUV if you're 5 or more.

faqs.question: Is the boat ride included?
faqs.answer: No — boats are run by the local cooperative and paid in cash on the spot.

faqs.question: Can we swim at Dawki?
faqs.answer: Swimming is allowed at Shnongpdeng, a short drive upstream, when the river is calm.
